description: Main source file for the Google Workspace CLI (gws), implementing command-line parsing, command execution, and integration with Google APIs via discovery documents.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, initializes environment and runs the CLI.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronous function that parses arguments, builds CLI, handles commands, and executes API methods.

methods.name: select_scope
methods.description: Selects the first scope from a list of scopes, assuming it is the broadest.

methods.name: parse_pagination_config
methods.description: Parses pagination-related flags into a PaginationConfig struct.

methods.name: parse_service_and_version
methods.description: Determines the API service name and version, considering flags and syntax.

methods.name: filter_args_for_subcommand
methods.description: Filters command-line arguments to prepare for subcommand parsing, removing flags like --api-version.

methods.name: parse_sanitize_config
methods.description: Creates a sanitization configuration from template and mode.

methods.name: resolve_method_from_matches
methods.description: Walks the parsed CLI matches to find the corresponding API method in the discovery document.

methods.name: print_usage
methods.description: Prints the CLI usage and help information.

methods.name: is_help_flag
methods.description: Checks if an argument is a help flag.

methods.name: is_version_flag
methods.description: Checks if an argument is a version flag.
